subject: Clerical Office Duties
examFormat: Two papers taken at one sitting. Paper 1 has fifty compulsory multiple-choice objective questions to be answered within 50 minutes for 30 marks. Paper 2 has one compulsory case study based on office situations (22 marks) and six other questions of which candidates answer any three (16 marks each); the paper carries 70 marks and lasts 2 hours 10 minutes.
excluded: The source text jumps from topic 5 (Stock Procedure) to topic 7 (Office Equipment/Machines), so no topic 6 appears in the extraction; nothing was invented to fill the gap.

topics.name: The Office
objectives: Identify the important roles played by each of the sections in an organization
Examine the linkages among the departments, sections and functions
Identify the interrelationship among heads of departments
Outline the relationship among office personnel in terms of their duties/functions in the office
Identify the differences between the different types of secretaries and state their duties
Give a detailed explanation of the personal and business attributes of office staff
Identify the importance of good social habit and personal hygiene
Explain time management and identify time management skills and time wasters in the office
Give the factors that determine choice of office layout and the reasons for planning an office
State the advantages and disadvantages of open and closed office layout
topics.content: Definition of an office. Functions: receiving, recording, processing/analysing, giving and storing information, and safeguarding/protecting assets. Sections: reception, general office, stores, mail room/registry. Departments: accounts, purchasing, sales, personnel/human resource, production, legal, administration, transport. Office personnel: office manager, office supervisor, general clerks, accounts clerks, data entry clerks, administrative assistants, secretaries (company secretary, private secretary, stenographer secretary), receptionist, typist, messenger. Professional image of office staff: personal and business attributes; social habits, personal hygiene and healthy lifestyle; time management. Layout: open and closed.

topics.name: Organisation
objectives: Explain the principles of organisation and how they can be applied in an organization
Draw an organizational chart and state its uses, advantages and disadvantages
topics.content: Principles of organisation: unity of objectives, span of control, authority and responsibility, delegation, unity of functions, unity of command, supervision, remuneration, accountability, esprit de corps. Organisational structure: line, line and staff, staff, functional and matrix structures. Organisational chart/organogram.

topics.name: Business Transactions
objectives: Identify the documents used in business transactions, their purposes and when to use them
Complete the documents
Describe the various methods of payment used in business and state their advantages and disadvantages
Explain the terminologies: wages, salaries, gross pay, net pay, allowances, basic pay and PAYE
Know the methods of determining workers' pay: piece rate, time rate, commission, flat rate, overtime and bonus
Prepare payroll for the payment of wages and salaries of staff with given information
Identify and explain the various types of taxes and their importance
Explain the terms petty cash and imprest system and complete the petty cash book
topics.content: Documents used in business transactions: letter of enquiry, price list/catalogue/quotation, local purchase order, order, proforma invoice, invoice, delivery note/waybill, debit note, credit note, statement of account, cheques/payment orders, receipt, purchase requisition. Methods of payment: cash, cheque, standing order, credit transfer, money transfer. Payroll handling. Tax regimes: VAT, income tax, communication service tax (CST), property tax, import/customs duty. Petty cash.

topics.name: Banking
objectives: Know the functions of Commercial, Development, Merchant, Rural/Community Banks and the Central Bank
Give examples of the various types of banks
State the features of the various accounts
Give the definition, types and features of a valid cheque, the parties to a cheque and the reasons for dishonouring cheques
Explain a crossed cheque, the various ways of crossing a cheque and the effect of the crossing
topics.content: Types of bank. Types of account: savings, current, fixed deposit. Cheques.

topics.name: Stock Procedure
objectives: Explain the term 'stock', the importance of stock keeping in business and the procedure for ordering stock from the manufacturer or supplier
State the duties of the storekeeper and the requirements of a good stock system
Describe the store requisition procedure
Explain stock, methods of stocktaking, stock records and types of stock records, and describe the use of documents such as bin card, tally card and purchase order
Explain the meaning and methods of stock valuation
topics.content: Ordering of stock. Duties of the storekeeper. Requisition procedure. Stock record and stocktaking: annual, periodic, perpetual. Stock control: minimum stock, maximum stock, re-order level. Stock valuation: cost price, average price, market price, lower price.

topics.name: Office Equipment/Machines
objectives: Mention and explain factors to be considered when purchasing office machines/equipment
Identify different office machines/equipment, their uses and the advantages and disadvantages of manual and electric machines
Describe how to maintain office machines/equipment
Give the meaning, components, types, peripheral devices, functions, uses, advantages and disadvantages of computers
Explain the basic terms used in computing, the functions of the Internet, Intranet and the Worldwide web, and mention service providers
topics.content: General office machines/equipment: computer, photocopier, risograph, collating machine, dictaphone, typewriters, duplicating machines, perforator, calculator, cash register, pager, fax machines, accounting machines, scanner. The computer and ICT. Mail room equipment/materials: letter opening machine, addressing machine, franking machine, shredding machine, scales, scissors, paper knife or blade, stapling machine, staple remover, guillotine.

topics.name: Communication
objectives: Describe the different forms of communication with examples and identify their advantages and disadvantages
Identify the differences between vertical, horizontal and diagonal communication
Explain and give examples of the various barriers to communication
State the parts, formats and uses of each type of business correspondence
Identify the types of reports and the purposes, characteristics and format of each
State the procedure for handling incoming and outgoing mail and complete the various books used in the process
State the duties of the officials at meetings
Mention and explain meeting terminologies such as notice, quorum, agenda, resolution, ad-hoc committee, minutes, motion, ex-officio and casting vote
Draft meeting documents from given information
topics.content: Meaning. Forms: verbal (oral, written), non-verbal, visual. Channels of communication. Barriers to effective communication: organisational, physical, psychological, socio-cultural. Business correspondence: letters (form letters, circulars), memos, reports (short formal, short informal, periodic/routine, special, statutory). Mail handling: mail room, incoming and outgoing mail, incoming and outgoing mail register, postage book, messenger's receipt book. Meetings: purpose and kinds of meetings; requirements for a valid meeting (chairperson, secretary, teller, scrutineer); meeting terminologies; preparation of meeting documents (notice, agenda, minutes).

topics.name: Business English
objectives: State the importance and purpose of proofreading
Correct errors in passages, expand office abbreviations and use them correctly
Know the basic rules for spellings, word division and punctuation
topics.content: Proofreading and office abbreviations. Spelling, word division and punctuation.

topics.name: Filing and Indexing
objectives: Explain filing, the features of a good filing system and the reasons for filing
Understand the rules for the various filing methods together with their advantages and disadvantages
Explain how each system operates and identify the advantages and disadvantages of each system
State the general rules for filing
Identify the types/forms of indexing and the importance of indexing
Explain electronic filing and state its advantages and disadvantages, e.g. microfilming/micrographics
Compare central and departmental filing and list their advantages and disadvantages
topics.content: Methods of classification: alphabetical, numerical, subject, geographical, chronological, alpha-numeric, subject-numeric. Systems of filing: lateral, suspension, vertical, horizontal. Rules for filing. Indexing and cross-referencing. Electronic filing. Central and departmental filing.

topics.name: Reference Books and Sources of Information
objectives: Mention information that could be obtained from each reference book
Identify the various sources of information with examples, e.g. revenue offices (taxes), Immigration Service (passport), embassies/high commissions (visa), banks (financial bulletins)
topics.content: Reference books: general (dictionary, encyclopaedia, almanac); places (atlas, site plan); specialized (trade journals, post office guide, telephone directory); government publications (Hansard, white paper, gazette, financial instructions, general orders). Sources of information: personal documents, driving documents, passport, visa, tax clearance. Business information: exchange rates, stock exchange listing, financial bulletins, employment opportunities.

topics.name: Post Office Services
objectives: Explain the use of each postal service
State the features and benefits of courier services
Mention and explain agency services provided by the post office
topics.content: Postal services: postage stamps, express mail, special mail, poste restante, private mail bag, registered mail, recorded delivery, airmail, business reply service, private mail box. Courier services: Expedited Mail Service (EMS), DHL, Federal Express (FedEx). Agency services. Remittance services: postal order, money transfer.

topics.name: Human Relations
objectives: Explain internal relations and public relations and identify ways of improving human relations
State the factors that promote public relations and ways of improving interpersonal skills
topics.content: Internal relations in the office. Relations with the public. Interpersonal skills.

topics.name: Health, Safety and Welfare in the Office
objectives: Identify and explain health hazards in the office
State the types of health hazards in the office and how they could be prevented
State the types and causes of accidents and measures to prevent them
Identify welfare services and benefits available to office staff and the advantages associated with them
topics.content: Health hazards in the office. Accidents in the office. Staff welfare.

topics.name: Pre-Employment Procedures
objectives: Design an advertisement
Write application letters with curriculum vitae
Know how to prepare for an interview
topics.content: Advertisement. Submission of letters of application and curriculum vitae. The interview.

topics.name: Entrepreneurship and Small-Scale Business
objectives: Explain the term 'entrepreneur' and give the general characteristics of an entrepreneur
Explain small scale business and identify the characteristics of a small scale enterprise
Identify the importance of small scale businesses in the society/country
